title: Manno Singh v. State of U.P. & Others
disposition: Writ petition allowed; family pension directed to be paid to the first (legally wedded) wife
headnote: Not a Supply Code case — a family-pension dispute between a first and second wife of a deceased municipal employee under the U.P. Nagar Palika (Non-Centralized Service Retirement) Benefits Regulations, 1984, turning on the definition of 'family' and the invalidity of a second marriage under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Two Allahabad High Court electricity-board pension precedents (Shakuntala Devi v. Executive Engineer, Electricity Transmission-I, U.P. Electricity Board; Poonam Devi v. Chief Engineer, Electricity Board) are cited only as persuasive analogues on the general 'nomination cannot defeat legally wedded wife's pension claim' principle, with no engagement with any Supply Code or Electricity Act provision.

holding_units.topic: Family pension dispute between two wives of a deceased municipal employee — no Supply Code content; cites electricity-board pension cases only as general persuasive analogues
holding_units.holding: The second marriage, contracted after the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 came into force, was null and void; the second wife does not fall within the definition of 'family' under Regulation 2(f), and a nomination in her favour cannot defeat the legally wedded first wife's entitlement to family pension under Regulation 7.
holding_units.flag: Recorded for completeness of the source corpus; cites electricity-board pension precedents (Shakuntala Devi, Poonam Devi) only as general analogues, not for any Supply Code holding — no Electricity Act/Supply Code provision is engaged.

authorities.name: Shakuntala Devi (Smt.) v. Executive Engineer, Electricity Transmission Ist, U.P. Electricity Board, Allahabad
authorities.proposition: A nomination in favour of a second wife cannot defeat the legally wedded first wife's claim to retiral benefits, provident fund, and Dying-in-Harness appointment.
authorities.how_treated: followed (as general persuasive analogue; not an electricity/Supply Code holding)

authorities.name: Poonam Devi (Smt.) v. Chief Engineer, Electricity Board and others
authorities.proposition: Similar view as Shakuntala Devi on the legally wedded wife's entitlement over a nominee second wife.
authorities.how_treated: followed (as general persuasive analogue; not an electricity/Supply Code holding)
